note: The input schema the server publishes to agents in tools/list: one key, which is one of the listed operations or an address to read. The owner designed the tool surface to be well under 1 KB, with a list of operations. The shape of an element is the form the map stores, which every read shows; the server checks each command against the full contract (mcp-tools.proposed.json) and answers a wrong one with the reason and a corrected command.
